package_info.why_malicious: The report is a high-level overview of supply chain attacks and does not analyze or describe any specific malicious software package or code. It references real-world incidents (SolarWinds Orion, Kaseya VSA, Codecov) but does not provide technical details, code snippets, or package-level metadata for any particular malicious package. As such, there is no actionable package-level information or code analysis available.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: The report does not provide technical details, code-level indicators, or specific detection strategies for any particular malware. It offers general advice on supply chain security, such as vendor risk assessment, contract clauses, monitoring, and employee training, but does not describe actionable detection strategies or indicators of compromise for specific malicious packages.
